title: Internal-storage clocks and messages
summary: Recognize clocks/message relative paths across internal storage and SD in both clock modes, on seed 74's folders of the board's own storage, with a managed internal deployment of the seven approved messages prepared for the board session. For matching paths and file types, a persistent Clocks dropdown offers SD card (default) and Internal storage through `clocks storage sd|internal` and the status member `clock_storage`, approved by the owner on 2026-11-09, who also extended the app's Clocks-only boundary to the board's own clocks/ and clocks/message/. No core memory. Implemented (tasks 1-4, the deployment rehearsed on the emulator) and delivered (task 5) in open PR #65, built on PR #63's branch; not merged, and the board session of the seven messages and the owner's LED and phone checks are open.
